settings.heading: Welcome to the Chicago Futures Salon
settings.subheading: Exploring futures thinking through Surrealist, Situationist, and Futurist methods
settings.quote_text: The marvelous is always beautiful, anything marvelous is beautiful, in fact only the marvelous is beautiful.

settings.title: Futures Thinking
settings.content: We explore multiple possible futures through creative methodologies, challenging assumptions about what tomorrow might bring. Our approach combines rigorous analysis with imaginative speculation.

settings.title: Invitation-Only Community
settings.content: Our salon brings together thought leaders, innovators, and creative thinkers to imagine and shape possible futures. We maintain an intimate setting to foster deep conversation and collaboration.

settings.title: Experimental Methods
settings.content: Drawing from Surrealism, Situationism, and Futurism, we employ games, scenarios, and provocations to unlock new perspectives. Our methods are designed to challenge conventional thinking.

settings.title: Chicago Focus
settings.content: While our methods are universal, our focus is local. We explore futures for Chicago and the Midwest, bringing global perspectives to regional challenges and opportunities.

settings.title: Futures Salon: Chicago 2050
settings.description: Join us for an evening exploring possible futures for Chicago through scenario planning, creative games, and futures mapping exercises. Limited to 20 participants.

settings.title: Surrealist Methods Workshop
settings.description: Explore Surrealist creative techniques adapted for futures thinking and strategic foresight. Hands-on workshop with experimental exercises.

settings.title: Futures Gaming Night
settings.description: An evening of futures-oriented card games and strategic scenarios. Bring your curiosity and imagination.
